patchGroups.groupName: STARPHONIC Bubinga 14x6 notes cleanup after pass 3

updates.notes.scoringBasis: Official Tama STARPHONIC Bubinga page confirms a Bubinga shell with Cordia outer ply language, Grooved Hoop, Tama bearing-edge feature language, Super Sensitive Hi-Carbon Snare Wire, and STARPHONIC feature system. Reputable dealer listings support 7mm, 8-ply Bubinga + 1 outer ply Cordia, Linear-Drive Strainer, detachable butt plate, and 20-strand Super Sensitive Hi-Carbon Snare Wires. Stock heads and snare bed type remain unconfirmed from official source.

patchGroups.groupName: STARPHONIC Spruce 14x6 notes cleanup after pass 3

updates.notes.scoringBasis: Official Tama STARPHONIC Spruce page confirms an 8.0mm, 9-ply Spruce shell, Grooved Hoop, and 20-strand Super Sensitive Hi-Carbon Snare Wires. Reputable dealer listings identify the throw-off and butt as Linear-Drive Strainer and Butt Plate, with MLS50A / MLS50B part references. Stock heads, bearing edge, and snare bed type remain unconfirmed from official source.
